gen-irish-grover-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch keeps things compact and approachable, with a clearly open e and short ascenders. Irish Grover is the one that swaggers, its soft stroke shifts making words look sturdy and large, while the sans-serif text simply stays out of its way.
gen-irish-grover-gf-savate: Savate is a clean sans-serif whose round o nearly matches its capital O and whose curves stay wide open. And Irish Grover's fun, organic bulk makes the contrast between them the best thing about the pair.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-tiktok-sans: Quirky, commanding, a bit theatrical: Metamorphous sets a high midline and generous sidebearings against TikTok Sans, whose x-height climbs close to cap height. The difference in attitude is the draw.
gen-gf-offside-gf-sono: Expressive curves that refuse to close define Offside, a widely tracked display face with no swells of weight at all. Sono follows with a plain sans body of lofty lowercase and generous letterspacing, so paragraphs would drift along unhurried.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-stack-sans-text: Wide, loud and loose, Revalia stretches its letters apart and leaves the g open at the bottom. But Stack Sans Text draws a marker-like constant line with big-bodied lowercase, so the sturdy text keeps the page grounded under that swagger.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-sulphur-point: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet, its letters split by wide bridges and its lowercase stretched upward. Sulphur Point does the quieter job, a sans-serif with dowel-like stems and bulky proportions that stays easy to follow while the heading makes the noise.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-yaldevi: Distinctive, a little mechanical: Tektur bends its pipe-cleaner strokes into wide terminal openings. Yaldevi, a sans-serif, does the calmer work, giving its oversized lowercase an e that opens clearly to the right, while the heading carries the personality.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Unica One draws every stroke at a single thickness, with a huge lowercase eye and daylight inside each curve. Schibsted Grotesk sits beside it as a friendlier sans, its open e and a with generous bowls softening the heading's command.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-sen: Stencil-cut and bold, Wallpoet lets paper show between its letters and sends lowercase climbing high. But Sen, a modern sans with constant-weight lines and curves that stop short of turning inward, gives that drama a smooth, sturdy partner.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-sofia-sans: Warnes tapers its ink strokes out before they touch. Sofia Sans, a modern sans-serif with rounded, open letters and no thick-and-thin modulation, would carry a long passage in a smooth, steady stream.
